faqs.question: How often do you publish new content?
faqs.answer: We publish 3–4 new articles every week, covering technology trends, practical tutorials, case studies, and business strategy for digital product teams.

faqs.question: Can I contribute a guest article?
faqs.answer: Yes! We accept guest contributions from practitioners in tech, design, and business. Submit your pitch to blog@divritin.com with your topic idea and a brief bio.

faqs.question: Are the articles beginner-friendly or advanced?
faqs.answer: We write for both. Each article is tagged with a difficulty level — beginner, intermediate, or advanced — so you can filter for your experience level.

faqs.question: Can I republish or share Divrit blog content?
faqs.answer: You can share articles freely with attribution. For republishing full articles on your own platform, please reach out to us for written permission.
